meta.source: Direct HTTP probes (homepage with Accept: text/markdown, homepage HTML, /robots.txt, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json, /.well-known/api-catalog)
meta.method: Single GET per URL, https only, redirects followed, identifying UA. null = not measured. JSON well-known checks reject HTML soft-404s. Homepage only; results reflect the vantage point and may differ for bot user agents.
meta.benchmark: Cloudflare Agent Readiness scan of the 200,000 most-visited domains: ~3.9% support markdown negotiation, ~4% declare AI usage preferences, <15 sites expose MCP server cards.
